steps.text: Charges that renew on their own are easy to forget. Tap Activity, then Toolbox at the top.
PocketBudJet finds the charges that repeat in your statements. A phone bill is a bill, not a subscription, so tap Not a subscription.
The rest are real. Tap Confirm all (3).
The top now shows what your subscriptions cost each month, and over a whole year.
To stop one, tap Find how to cancel.
Open search finds its cancel page in your browser. Once you've cancelled, tap Mark as cancelled.
It's taken off your monthly total and counted in your savings. Changed your mind? Tap Undo.
